listingTitle: Stop commanding an entity after despawn
title: Stop commanding an entity after despawn
why: Bevy applies Commands later in queue order, so a command targeting an entity after its queued despawn can fail with runtime error B0003.
suggestion: Queue all required changes before despawn, or stop issuing commands for that entity once despawn has been requested.
limitations: Only direct Commands::entity calls using the same simple identifier or field path in one function are ordered.
Cross-system entity identity, aliases, command closures, and custom commands are not resolved.
